mapper.select:
SELECT TOP (#{pg} * #{pgCnt}) WI.일련번호 AS WI_ID , (CASE WHEN ISDATE(WI.작성일자) = 1 THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CONVERT (DATE, WI.작성일자) , 126) ELSE WI.작성일자 END) AS WI_WRITEDT , WI.거래처코드 AS WI_BCNCCODE , WI.진행상태 AS WI_PROGRSSE , (CASE WHEN WI.진행상태 = 'A' THEN '미확인' WHEN WI.진행상태 = 'B' THEN '확인중' ELSE '확인완료' END) AS WI_PROGRSSECHG , WI.거래처작성자 AS WI_BCNCWRTER , (SELECT TOP 1 RTRIM(CM2.상호) FROM 거래처MASTER CM2 WHERE CM2.거래처코드 = WI.거래처코드) AS CM_DLVYENTRPSNM , WI.제목 AS WI_TITLE , WI.내용 AS WI_CN , WI.답변일자 AS WI_ANSWERDT , (SELECT TOP 1 RTRIM(V.성명) FROM 웹개인기본_VIEW V WHERE V.사번 = WI.답변자) AS WI_ANSWRR , WI.답변 AS WI_ANSWER , WI.등록자 AS WI_REGISTER
ORDER BY WI.작성일자 DESC, WI.일련번호 DESC

SELECT WI.일련번호 AS WI_ID , (CASE WHEN ISDATE(WI.작성일자) = 1 THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CONVERT (DATE, WI.작성일자) , 126) ELSE WI.작성일자 END) AS WI_WRITEDT , WI.거래처코드 AS WI_BCNCCODE , WI.진행상태 AS WI_PROGRSSE , (CASE WHEN WI.진행상태 = 'A' THEN '미확인' WHEN WI.진행상태 = 'B' THEN '확인중' ELSE '확인완료' END) AS WI_PROGRSSECHG , WI.거래처작성자 AS WI_BCNCWRTER , (SELECT TOP 1 RTRIM(CM2.상호) FROM 거래처MASTER CM2 WHERE CM2.거래처코드 = WI.거래처코드) AS CM_DLVYENTRPSNM , WI.제목 AS WI_TITLE , WI.내용 AS WI_CN , WI.답변일자 AS WI_ANSWERDT , (SELECT TOP 1 RTRIM(V.성명) FROM 웹개인기본_VIEW V WHERE V.사번 = WI.답변자) AS WI_ANSWRR , WI.답변 AS WI_ANSWER , WI.등록자 AS WI_REGISTER
WHERE WI.일련번호 = #{WI_ID}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO 웹거래처문의 ( 일련번호 , 작성일자 , 거래처코드 , 진행상태 , 거래처작성자 , 제목 , 내용 , 답변일자 , 답변자 , 답변 , 등록자 , 등록일자 , 등록시간 , 수정자 , 수정일자 , 수정시간 ) VALUES ( (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(일련번호+1),1) FROM 웹거래처문의) , CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112) , #{WI_BCNCCODE} , #{WI_PROGRSSE} , #{WI_BCNCWRTER} , #{WI_TITLE} , #{WI_CN} , CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112) , #{bcncCode} , #{WI_ANSWER} , #{bcncCode} , CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112) , REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),108),':','') , #{bcncCode} , CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112) , REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),108),':','') )
